overall: The AG found no violation: the November 14 minutes were still in draft when the complaint was filed, and a public body may revise draft minutes before approval. The complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the November 14 Board minutes were incomplete and omitted a list of documents used at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because the minutes were in draft form at the time of this complaint, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by creating inaccurate or insufficiently detailed minutes.
